name: northwind-support-challenge
description: Challenge set — NOT a merge gate. Hard cases written after the thresholds were chosen: paraphrases that share few words with the documents, and near-topic questions the documents do not answer (on-topic enough to fool similarity search). It tracks progress on unsolved problems; promote a case to dataset.json once the system handles it reliably.

cases.question: How are customers billed if they choose yearly payment?
cases.ground_truth: Customers who pay annually receive a 15 percent discount.
expected_context: Customers who pay annually receive a 15 percent discount

cases.question: Is my information encrypted when stored?
cases.ground_truth: Yes, customer data is encrypted at rest with AES-256.
expected_context: All customer data is encrypted at rest with AES-256

cases.question: Which ciphers protect traffic over the network?
cases.ground_truth: Data in transit is protected with TLS 1.3.

cases.question: How quickly will I hear about a breach?
cases.ground_truth: Security incidents are reported to affected customers within 72 hours.
expected_context: Security incidents are reported to affected customers within 72 hours

cases.question: Where are your servers located?
cases.ground_truth: Customer data is hosted in the Frankfurt and Paris regions.
expected_context: Customer data is hosted in the Frankfurt and Paris regions

cases.question: What happens if I send too many API calls?
cases.ground_truth: The API returns HTTP status 429 with a Retry-After header.
expected_context: When the rate limit is exceeded the API returns HTTP status 429

cases.question: How do I authenticate against the API?
cases.ground_truth: Requests are authenticated with a bearer token created in the admin console.
expected_context: Requests are authenticated with a bearer token

cases.question: How long is a trashed file recoverable?
cases.ground_truth: Deleted files stay in the trash for 30 days.
expected_context: Deleted files stay in the trash for 30 days

cases.question: Can I log in with my company identity provider?
cases.ground_truth: Yes, single sign-on is available through SAML 2.0 and OpenID Connect on Team and Enterprise.
expected_context: Single sign-on is available through SAML 2.0 and OpenID Connect

cases.question: Is there a status page?
cases.ground_truth: Yes, the public status page is available at status.northwind.example.
expected_context: The public status page is available at status.northwind.example

cases.question: What is the monthly price for Starter?
cases.ground_truth: The Starter plan costs 12 euros per user per month.
expected_context: The Starter plan costs 12 euros per user per month
